description: A Director of Engineering must finalize the production rollout policy for a real-time collaboration service, including rollout scope, connection limits, client retry behavior, data handling, and account exclusions, after the standard launch-readiness review.

shared_context.S1: The real-time collaboration service is scheduled for production launch Monday at 09:00 UTC.
shared_context.S2: The service passed its planned staging tests, including functional, failover, and basic load tests.
shared_context.S3: The draft launch plan enables the feature for 10% of accounts initially, permits up to 10,000 concurrent connections, uses the client library's default 5-second retry interval, stores collaboration data in the primary production region, and retains session transcripts for 90 days.
shared_context.S4: Before the launch plan is finalized, the standard readiness review gives backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success a separate final check-in before Maya records the binding policy.

PF1.text: While investigating an unrelated mobile performance report this afternoon, Rafael confirmed that mobile clients resume from background in bursts and currently retry every 5 seconds, which can create a reconnect storm; the rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds. He has not yet filed the client-library ticket.

PF2.text: Lin completed a production-traffic replay 20 minutes ago and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections; the autoscaling limit in the draft has not been updated because the replay results are still being attached to the capacity worksheet.

PF3.text: Nadia finished a privacy review this morning and confirmed that collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region and that session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days; she has not opened the compliance ticket because legal was still reviewing the wording.

PF4.text: Owen reconciled the customer-success rollout spreadsheet an hour ago and confirmed that accounts acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 have administrator opt-out commitments until their enablement sessions are complete; those six accounts must be excluded from Monday's rollout. He has not updated the launch checklist yet.

acceptance_conditions: The rollout must exclude the six named opted-out accounts from Monday's rollout.
The production connection ceiling must be exactly 6,000 concurrent connections.
The client retry interval must be exactly 30 seconds.
Collaboration data for EU accounts must use the EU processing region.
Session transcripts must be retained for exactly 30 days.
Exactly the six opted-out accounts must be excluded from Monday's rollout.
The plan must include commitments for the retry-interval change, connection-cap enforcement, privacy compliance, and updating the account-exclusion checklist.
The reconnect-storm finding must be cited as a reason for the retry setting.

content_checks.C1: decisions['rollout_mode'] in ['account_allowlist', '10% initial rollout with six accounts excluded', '10% initial rollout excluding six accounts', '10% rollout with six accounts excluded', '10% rollout excluding six accounts', '10% of accounts, excluding the six flagged accounts']
content_checks.C4: decisions['data_processing_region'] in ['EU', 'EU processing region', 'EU processing region for EU accounts', 'EU processing region for EU accounts; primary production region for non-EU accounts']
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Rafael' and 'retry' in c['detail'] and ('30' in c['detail'] or 'thirty' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Lin' and (('autoscaling' in c['detail'] and ('6,000' in c['detail'] or '6000' in c['detail'])) or ('connection cap' in c['detail'] and ('6,000' in c['detail'] or '6000' in c['detail']))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Nadia' and 'EU' in c['detail'] and ('30' in c['detail'] or 'thirty' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'Owen' and 'acct-204' in c['detail'] and 'acct-219' in c['detail'] and 'acct-233' in c['detail'] and 'acct-241' in c['detail'] and 'acct-278' in c['detail'] and 'acct-301' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The draft uses a 5-second retry interval; PF1 changes it to exactly 30 seconds and adds a client-library retry-change commitment.
The draft allows 10,000 concurrent connections; PF2 changes the production ceiling to exactly 6,000 and requires the autoscaling or connection cap to enforce that limit.
The draft uses the primary region and 90-day retention; PF3 changes EU-account processing to the EU region, retention to exactly 30 days, and adds a compliance-ticket commitment for those controls.

The draft enables a percentage of accounts; PF4 changes the rollout to exclude exactly acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 and requires the launch checklist to record those exclusions.
